figurative_meaning_en: In every place, at every level
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজের রন্ধ্রে রন্ধ্রে অশিক্ষা ছড়িয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Illiteracy has spread in every nook and cranny of society.

note: Often used to describe widespread negative phenomena like corruption.
